title: US Navy 100721-N-1092P-047 Aviation Machinist's Mate 2nd Class Robert Inwood cleans up fuel and hydraulic fluid in the hangar bay of USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75)
description: ARABIAN GULF (July 21, 2010) Aviation Machinist's Mate 2nd Class Robert Inwood, assigned to the Zappers of Electronic Attack Squadron (VAQ) 130, cleans up fuel and hydraulic fluid in the hangar bay of the aircraft carrier USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75). VAQ-130 is deployed as part of the Harry S. Truman Carrier Strike Group supporting maritime security operations and theater security cooperation efforts in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of responsibility. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Stuart Phillips/Released)
